name: Arkansas Mountain

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: An AVA in the Ozark Mountains of Arkansas, split by the Arkansas River. It sits inside the multi-state Ozark Mountain AVA and contains the smaller Altus AVA, which shares its terroir. It was created in 1986 on a petition from Wiederkehr Wine Cellars.
